name: Hugo
summary: Hugo allows AI-assisted contributions with limits: a substantial AI-generated contribution must be disclosed in the pull request with the extent of assistance, and contributors must manually verify and understand the code. AI contributions from non-maintainers must be fairly narrow in scope, such as a bug fix.

evidence.quote: If a substantial part of your contribution is autogenerated with AI, **this must be disclosed in the pull request**, along with the extent to which AI assistance was used.
AI contributions from non-maintainers needs to have a fairly narrow scope (e.g. a bug fix), as we have limited review capacity.
We expect contributors to manually verify that the state of the pull request is OK (e.g. that the CLI is signed).
We expect contributors to understand the code that is produced and be able to answer critical questions about it

Manually verify the pull request state, e.g. that the CLI is signed
Understand the generated code and answer critical questions about it

rules.note: AI-written small fixes are allowed if disclosed in the PR, manually verified and understood; non-maintainers must keep AI contributions to a narrow scope such as a bug fix.
